title: Ish-bosheth
summary: Son of Saul, king of Israel during the civil war with David.
description: Son of Saul, king of Israel during the civil war with David. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 1, "Chronology of Neighboring Kings to Israel in the 11th Century"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start: 1056; End: 1049). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.
